landing.heroDescription: AI-powered verification and blockchain traceability for a more transparent, secure, and authentic Ayurvedic supply chain.
landing.demoDescription: Watch how our platform creates an unbroken chain of trust from farm to pharmacy. Every step is verified, recorded, and easily accessible.
landing.immutableRecordsDesc: Every transaction and quality check is permanently recorded on the blockchain, eliminating the possibility of fraud.
landing.integratedLabReportsDesc: Instantly access AI-verified quality certificates and lab test results for every batch of raw materials.
landing.farmToConsumerDesc: Empower consumers to trace the complete journey of their Ayurvedic products by simply scanning a QR code.
landing.howItWorksSub: Swipe through the 5 stages of Dravya's Ayurvedic supply chain verification.
landing.step1Desc: Farmers log raw herb origin, geo-location, and harvest batch data directly onto the platform.
landing.step2Desc: Certified labs verify heavy metals, purity, moisture levels, and authenticity metrics.
landing.step3Desc: Manufacturers process herbs into formulations with full environmental and parameter logs.
landing.step4Desc: Distributors and retailers maintain temperature, custody, and real-time location logs.
landing.step5Desc: End consumers scan a QR code on packaging to view the complete lab & journey audit trail.
landing.aiDesc: Dravya replaces manual inspection with advanced computer vision. Our models instantly identify medicinal herbs, detect impurities, and cryptographically anchor the results to the blockchain.
landing.intelligentRecDesc: Scans biological markers to identify exact species and varieties with over 99.8% precision, ensuring authentic sourcing.
landing.qualityAssessmentDesc: Automatically flags visual defects, discoloration, or potential foreign contaminants in the batch before processing.
landing.immutableLoggingDesc: Verification data is hashed and permanently stored, creating an unalterable proof of origin on the blockchain.

veinMap.title: Supply Chain Across India
veinMap.subtitle: Trace the verified journey of Ayurvedic herbs — from farm to blockchain, state by state.
veinMap.clickToView: Click a stage to view details:

stage3.title: Regulatory Officer Stamp

stage4.title: GMP Extraction & Production

stage5.title: Anchored On Blockchain

about.subtitle: Ayurvedic medicine runs on trust — but trust without proof is just a promise. Dravya makes that proof possible, tracking every herb from the soil it grew in to the shelf it reaches.
about.bringingTransparencyDesc1: Adulteration, mislabeling, and counterfeit herbs quietly erode trust in Ayurvedic medicine. Dravya exists to close that gap — connecting ancient wisdom with modern accountability.
about.bringingTransparencyDesc2: We combine blockchain immutability with AI-powered verification to create an unbroken, tamper-proof record — from farm to pharmacy.
about.howWeGotHereSub: Building the infrastructure for authentic, tamper-proof herbal medicine.
about.peopleBehindSub: A dedicated team of software developers, AI engineers, and researchers building the digital infrastructure for authentic Ayurveda.

timeline.step1Desc: Noticed how often ayurvedic products like Adivasi Oil were being sold as counterfeit, and realized traceability across the Ayurvedic supply chain was almost non-existent.
timeline.step2Desc: Started building Dravya, referencing frameworks like Anvesha and Ministry of AYUSH guidelines to shape the traceability model.
timeline.step3Desc: Expanding to more producers, manufacturers, and labs nationwide, while integrating AI — including a chatbot assistant — to make the platform more interactive and accessible.
timeline.step4Desc: We are constantly adding new AI capabilities, laboratory integrations, and enhanced blockchain auditing tools to Dravya. Stay tuned for more features!

features.subtitle: Dravya brings together AI, blockchain, and real-time data to give every stakeholder in the Ayurvedic supply chain complete visibility and control.
features.scannerTitle: Every batch, authenticated before it moves
features.scannerDesc: Computer vision flags species mismatches and contaminants in seconds, before a batch is passed downstream.
features.builtForEveryLink: Built for every link in the chain
features.builtForEveryLinkSub: Seamlessly integrating AI computer vision with decentralized blockchain record-keeping.
features.everythingElseSub: Enterprise-grade tools designed for speed, security, and effortless adoption.

coreAi.title: AI / ML Prediction Engine
coreAi.desc: Deep Learning-based Medicinal Plant & Herb Image Classification, trained on Kaggle datasets via the PlantPredictor inference pipeline. Returns a confidence score and AI verification status, with canonical species and botanical taxonomy mapping.

batchEngine.title: Batch & Inventory Intelligence
batchEngine.desc: Unique deterministic Batch ID generation (DRAVYA-<HERB>-<DATE>-<SUFFIX>), automatic quantity normalization across units, herb-wise and farmer-wise batch organization, and full inventory tracking with search and retrieval.

blockchain.title: Traceability / Blockchain Ready
blockchain.desc: Every batch produces a blockchain-ready traceability payload with a SHA-256 tamper-evident hash linking AI prediction, batch data, farmer, and quantity — designed for future smart-contract and blockchain integration.
blockchain.h3: AI prediction + batch + farmer + quantity linked
blockchain.h6: On-chain log for every transfer event

quality.title: Validation & Reliability
quality.desc: Pydantic request validation, confidence-based verification tiers (AI_CONFIRMED / REVIEW_REQUIRED / LOW_CONFIDENCE), complete error handling (404/400/422), and 237 automated tests + live API E2E verification.

additional.batchCreate: Register a new herb batch with GPS, species, quantity, and farmer details. Generates deterministic Batch ID.
additional.batchCreateImg: Upload a herb image; AI classifies species, maps taxonomy, and auto-creates a verified batch.
additional.batchGet: Retrieve full batch record including AI prediction, farmer, quantity, and verification status.
additional.batchTrace: Returns the blockchain-ready traceability payload with SHA-256 hash for on-chain anchoring.
additional.invSummary: Aggregated total inventory across all herbs and farmers with normalization to kg.
additional.realtimeAlertsDesc: Instant notifications for failed quality checks, batch transfers, and certification expirations.

howItWorks.heroDesc: Learn how Dravya empowers Farmers, Distributors, Manufacturers, Verification Officers, and Consumers with role-based access, QR batch verification, AI prediction models, and a consumer batch rating system.
howItWorks.rolesSubtitle: Select your role to see a tailored walkthrough of your Dravya experience.

farmer.label: Farmer
farmer.headline: Your harvest earns the trust it deserves
farmer.tagline: From your field to the blockchain — every harvest verified.
farmer.description: Dravya gives farmers a powerful digital identity for every herb batch they grow. Register your farm, log harvest details with GPS coordinates, and mint a tamper-proof QR code. Buyers instantly know your batch is genuine — and your reputation grows with every verified delivery.
farmer.step1Desc: Log your farm GPS location, herb species, harvest date and quantity. Dravya mints a unique on-chain batch record.
farmer.step2Desc: A tamper-proof QR code is generated for your batch — the digital passport that travels with your herbs.
farmer.step3Desc: Every successful delivery earns you a public quality score. Buyers prefer farmers with verified, rated batches.
farmer.step4Desc: See exactly where your batch is — from your farm to the manufacturer — with full custody transfer logs.

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer
manufacturer.headline: Guarantee the purity of what you manufacture
manufacturer.tagline: Process with confidence. Every input verified before it enters your facility.
manufacturer.description: Manufacturers receive blockchain-verified herb batches and log every processing step — from extraction ratios to environmental conditions. Dravya's AI pre-screens incoming raw material quality so you only work with authenticated inputs, protecting your brand and compliance record.
manufacturer.step1Desc: Scan the farmer's QR code to instantly verify batch origin, AI quality score, and chain of custody before accepting.
manufacturer.step2Desc: Dravya AI models run species purity and compound analysis on incoming batches, flagging adulterated or substandard inputs.
manufacturer.step3Desc: Record extraction ratios, temperature, formulation details and batch splits — every parameter anchored immutably on-chain.
manufacturer.step4Desc: Generate a final product QR linking finished goods back to the verified raw input batch for end-to-end traceability.

lab.label: Lab
lab.headline: Turn your lab reports into on-chain evidence
lab.tagline: Your analysis anchors scientific truth on an immutable ledger.
lab.description: Accredited laboratories connect directly to Dravya to upload certified test results — phytochemical profiles, heavy metal panels, microbial counts — tied to a specific batch hash. Lab findings are immutably stored and instantly accessible to manufacturers, officers, and consumers.
lab.step1Desc: Dravya flags incoming batches requiring lab analysis. Labs receive sample metadata and batch QR hash for traceability.
lab.step2Desc: Conduct phytochemical, microbial, and heavy metal tests. Upload results with your accreditation certificate reference.
lab.step3Desc: Your signed lab report is hashed and anchored on the blockchain alongside the batch record — tamper-proof and timestamped.
lab.step4Desc: Manufacturers, verification officers, and consumers can instantly verify your lab report is genuine and unaltered.

authority.label: Verification Authority
authority.headline: Anchor regulatory trust directly on the blockchain
authority.tagline: Audit with confidence. Sign with authority. Enforce at scale.
authority.description: Certified AYUSH & Government Verification Officers get a dedicated auditor portal. Review physical inventory, validate laboratory reports, and stamp multi-signature digital approvals on-chain. Every officer action is immutably recorded, creating a nationwide, tamper-proof compliance trail.
authority.step1Desc: View all pending batch verifications across registered farmers and manufacturers in your jurisdiction.
authority.step2Desc: Cross-reference physical inventory with AI predictions and submitted lab reports before issuing a compliance clearance.
authority.step3Desc: Issue your cryptographic verification signature — anchored on-chain, visible to all downstream stakeholders.
authority.step4Desc: Monitor regulatory compliance across thousands of batches in real-time with AYUSH-grade audit trails.

workflow.title: What happens at each stage of Dravya?
workflow.subtitle: Detailed breakdown of how user roles, batch QR code verification, AI predictions, AYUSH verification officers, and batch rating systems work together.
workflow.step1Desc: Any user accessing Dravya selects their specific role: Farmer, Distributor, Manufacturer, Verification Officer, or Consumer. Role-gated dashboards ensure each stakeholder accesses customized smart contract actions and verified access levels.
workflow.step1D1: Role selection upon portal login (Farmer, Manufacturer, Distributor, Officer)
workflow.step1D3: Role-based access control (RBAC) for smart contracts
workflow.step1D4: Unified single sign-on with cryptographic verification
workflow.step2Desc: The farmer/collector registers a batch with farm GPS, species name, and harvest date. Dravya generates a unique batch QR code. At every custody transfer (Farmer → Distributor → Manufacturer), scanning the QR code instantly verifies if it is the exact registered batch.
workflow.step2D1: GPS-tagged origin logging & digital batch minting
workflow.step2D2: Unique tamper-proof QR code generated for every batch
workflow.step2D3: Instant mobile QR scan to confirm batch identity on transfer
workflow.step3Desc: Before processing, raw herb samples are scanned by Dravya AI models. Computer vision and predictive analysis evaluate species purity, moisture levels, active compounds (e.g. Withanolides in Ashwagandha), and detect potential adulteration.
workflow.step3D1: AI species prediction & visual purity check
workflow.step3D4: Instant confidence score stored alongside lab results
workflow.step4Desc: As Dravya expands to nationwide scale, certified AYUSH & Government Verification Officers log into specialized auditor dashboards. Officers inspect physical inventory, validate lab reports, and anchor digital verification sign-offs on the blockchain.
workflow.step5Desc: Manufacturers accept verified batches and log processing parameters (temperature, extract ratio, batch splitting). Distributors update transit timestamps and environmental logs on the immutable blockchain ledger.
workflow.step5D1: Unbroken chain of custody from farm to factory
workflow.step6Desc: End consumers scan the QR code on the final packaging to view the complete journey map. Consumers can leave reviews and star ratings tied directly to that batch number, providing transparent public feedback on seller quality.
workflow.step6D1: Instant consumer QR scan for complete origin map
workflow.step6D2: Batch-specific rating & review desk for consumers
workflow.step6D3: Transparent seller quality score based on verified batch reviews
workflow.step6D4: Builds market credibility for authentic Ayurvedic producers

goldStandard.title: Why Dravya sets the gold standard for Ayurvedic herbs
goldStandard.f1Desc: Using machine learning to predict herb authenticity and active compound levels before batch approval, preventing market adulteration.
goldStandard.f2Desc: Enabling certified AYUSH & Government Verification Officers to audit batches physically and stamp digital signatures on the blockchain.
goldStandard.f3Desc: Empowering consumers and buyers to review specific batches, creating transparent quality ratings for farmers, manufacturers, and sellers.
